roots.note: 停 = stop or halt. It appears on road signs, bus stops, train stops, and parking restrictions.

members.breakdown: 停 stop + 留 remain + 場 place
一時 temporary + 停止 stop

roots.note: 發 = start, send out, or occur. It connects departures, mailings, documents, announcements, and incidents.

members.breakdown: 出 go out + 發 start
發 send out + 送 send
發 make public + 表 show

roots.note: 到 = arrive or reach. It is useful in transit schedules, delivery tracking, and destination messages.

members.breakdown: 到着 arrival + 豫定 scheduled
商品 product + 到着 arrival

roots.note: 乘 = ride or board. It appears throughout station signs, transfers, passengers, and platforms.

members.breakdown: 乘 board + 降 get off + 場 place

roots.note: 換 = change or exchange. It appears in transfers, product exchanges, currency exchange, and conversion.
速 = speed or fast. It helps with traffic signs, express service, wind reports, and quick processing.
急 = urgent or sudden. It appears in emergencies, express trains, urgent notices, and sudden stops.
方 = direction, side, or method. It appears in navigation, two-way signs, regions, and instructions.
位 = position or rank. It helps with maps, rankings, measurement units, and social position.
地 = land or place. It appears in underground signs, maps, regions, destinations, and ground level.
區 = district or section. It appears in addresses, district offices, zones, and classifications.

members.breakdown: 行政 administration + 區域 district

roots.note: 洞 = neighborhood-level administrative area. It is the 동 seen in Korean addresses and resident centers.

members.breakdown: 洞 neighborhood + 住民 resident + 센터 center
法定 legally set + 洞 neighborhood

roots.note: 民 = people. It appears in resident services, citizens, national identity, civil complaints, and private-sector labels.
登 = register or go up. It appears in registration, legal records, hiking, appearances, and school attendance.
錄 = record. Its usual reading is 록, but it becomes 녹 at the start of words such as 녹음 and 녹화.
證 = proof or certificate. It is common on IDs, receipts, licenses, authentication, and evidence.

members.breakdown: 證 prove + 明 clear + 書 document

roots.note: 申 = state or submit. It appears in applications, reports to authorities, and the forms used for both.
請 = request. It appears in applications, requests, billing claims, petitions, and invitations.
記 = write down or record. It appears in records, articles, diaries, reviews, and form entries.
報 = report or inform. It connects information, reports, forecasts, news coverage, and alerts.
知 = know. It appears in public notices, knowledge, recognition, notifications, and instructions you must understand.
情 = feeling or circumstances. It connects information with personal situations, emotions, and surrounding facts.

members.breakdown: 個人 personal + 情報 information

roots.note: 法 = law, rule, or method. It appears in legal notices as well as ordinary instructions for how to use something.
規 = rule or standard. It appears in building rules, official regulations, size, and regular status.
則 = rule or principle. It appears in rules, safety instructions, general principles, and regular patterns.
郵 = mail or postal service. It appears in post offices, postal items, postal codes, and registered mail.

members.breakdown: 郵 postal + 遞 deliver + 局 office
郵便 postal + 番號 number
登記 registered + 郵便 mail

roots.note: 契 = contract or agreement. It appears in rental contracts, deposits, and written agreements.

members.breakdown: 傳貰 jeonse + 契約 contract
賃貸借 rental + 契約 contract

roots.note: 約 = promise or agreement. It appears in appointments, reservations, contracts, terms, and cancellations.
貸 = lend or lease. It appears in rental housing, loans, landlords, and rental fees.

members.breakdown: 傳貰 jeonse + 貸出 loan

roots.note: 借 = borrow or rent. It appears on leases when describing tenants, borrowed items, and borrowed money.

members.breakdown: 借 borrow + 入 bring in

roots.note: 賃 = rent or payment for use. It is one of the most important roots in Korean housing contracts.
納 = pay in or submit. It appears on bills, payment deadlines, overdue notices, and payment records.

members.breakdown: 納 pay in + 付 hand over
收 receive + 納 take in
納付 payment + 期限 deadline

roots.note: 付 = hand over or entrust. It appears in payments, document issuance, sending, assigning, and favors.

members.breakdown: 納 pay in + 付 hand over
交 transfer + 付 hand over
送 send + 付 hand over

roots.note: 額 = amount. It appears on bills, account balances, totals, small payments, and spending limits.
計 = calculate or plan. It appears in checkout totals, statistics, plans, and bank accounts.
保 = protect or keep. It connects insurance, guardians, storage, guarantees, and public health.
障 = obstacle or barrier. It appears in accessibility, equipment failures, guarantees, and disruptions.
銀 = silver. In daily Korean, learners most often meet it in 은행 and related banking expressions.

members.breakdown: 銀行 bank + 計座 account
銀行 bank + 業務 business
銀行 bank + 移替 transfer

roots.note: 貯 = save or store. It appears in savings accounts, stored data, reservoirs, and putting money aside.
稅 = tax. It appears in tax bills, income tax, value-added tax, tax-free shopping, and tax rates.

members.breakdown: 附加 added value + 稅 tax

roots.note: 商 = commerce. It appears in products, shops, shopping districts, commercial activity, and merchants.
業 = work or business. It appears in opening hours, duties, jobs, businesses, and closure notices.
販 = sell or retail. It appears in listings, vending machines, sellers, and online sales notices.

members.breakdown: 自 automatic + 販 sell + 機 machine
販賣 selling + 中 in progress
通信 remote communication + 販賣 sales

roots.note: 達 = reach. It connects delivery, conveying messages, reaching a point, development, and achievement.
着 = arrive, attach, or wear. It appears in arrival updates, first-come service, clothing, seating, and labels.

members.breakdown: 先 first + 着 arrive + 順 order

roots.note: 完 = complete. It appears in completed deliveries, finished work, full payment, and incomplete status labels.

members.breakdown: 未 not yet + 完了 complete

roots.note: 了 = finish. It usually appears as 료 at the end of words marking completion or termination.

members.breakdown: 修 complete study + 了 finish

roots.note: 取 = take or obtain. It appears in cancellations, receiving parcels, acquiring things, handling, and collection.
消 = remove or use up. It appears in cancellations, disinfection, consumption, digestion, and resolving problems.

members.breakdown: 消 use up + 費 spend

roots.note: 返 = return or send back. It is useful for returns, parcel redelivery, borrowed items, and refunds in kind.

members.breakdown: 返 return + 還 give back

roots.note: 退 = leave or withdraw. It appears in hospital discharge, leaving work, checkout, moving out, and unsubscribing.
選 = choose. It appears in choices, elections, selections, and people or items chosen from a group.

members.breakdown: 選 choose + 拔 pick out

roots.note: 檢 = inspect or check. It appears in medical tests, searches, maintenance checks, and reviews.
査 = examine or investigate. It appears in medical tests, surveys, reviews, audits, and field checks.

members.breakdown: 現場 site + 調査 investigation

roots.note: 療 = medical treatment. It is usually 료 inside words, but becomes 요 at the start of 요양.

members.breakdown: 療 treatment + 養 nurture; initial 료 becomes 요
再活 rehabilitation + 治療 treatment

roots.note: 治 = heal or put in order. In daily life it appears most often in treatment, healing, and public safety.
痛 = pain. It helps decode clinic questions about pain location, headaches, stomachaches, and painkillers.

members.breakdown: 鎭 calm + 痛 pain + 劑 medicine
痛症 pain + 이 있다 exist

roots.note: 傷 = injury or damage. It appears in wounds, burns, injuries, and damage reports.
感 = feel or be affected. It connects colds, emotions, infections, sensitivity, and empathy.

members.breakdown: 感 be affected + 染 contaminate

roots.note: 染 = dye or contaminate. It appears in infection notices, contagious disease, pollution, and hair dyeing.

members.breakdown: 感 be affected + 染 contaminate

roots.note: 護 = protect or care for. It appears in guardians, nurses, patient care, and protective actions.
救 = rescue or aid. It appears on ambulances, emergency services, rescue notices, and relief support.

members.breakdown: 救 aid + 急 urgent + 車 vehicle
應急 emergency + 救助 rescue

roots.note: 效 = effect. It appears in medicine effectiveness, functions, validity, and ineffective status labels.
副 = secondary or deputy. The most useful health word is 부작용, a side effect; it also marks deputy roles.

members.breakdown: 副 deputy + 社長 company head

roots.note: 話 = talk or conversation. It connects phones, calls, dialogue, speaking practice, and discussion topics.
言 = speech or words. It appears in language, statements, advice, declarations, and mentions.
語 = language or word. It appears in language names, vocabulary, and foreign-language labels.

members.breakdown: 外國 foreign country + 語 language

roots.note: 聞 = hear or news. It appears in newspapers, rumors, firsthand knowledge, and hearsay.
見 = see or view. It appears in opinions, discoveries, study visits, estimates, and personal views.

members.breakdown: 發 bring out + 見 see

roots.note: 名 = name. It appears in famous places, business cards, name lists, place names, and signatures.
先 = first or ahead. It appears in teachers, priority, first-come service, prepayment, and advance payment.

members.breakdown: 先 earlier + 生 born/person + 님 honorific
先 first + 着 arrive + 順 order

roots.note: 子 = child or a small unit. It appears in family words, men and women, electronics, and snacks.
女 = woman or female. Its regular reading is 녀, but it becomes 여 at the start of 여자 and 여성.

members.breakdown: 女 female + 子 person; initial 녀 becomes 여
女 female + 性 quality; initial 녀 becomes 여

roots.note: 男 = man or male. It appears in gender labels and family words for sons.
新 = new. It appears in new registrations, products, arrivals, construction, and the latest version.
古 = old. It appears in secondhand goods, classics, historic places, and old or scrap items.
高 = high. It appears in speed, floors, prices, temperature, and maximum labels.
低 = low. It appears in budget prices, lower floors, low temperature, minimum levels, and low income.
同 = same or together. It appears in identical status, shared action, simultaneous events, agreement, and colleagues.
別 = separate or different. It appears in special cases, separate fees, distinctions, farewells, and discrimination.
